Modified for HomePod Bridge: optional stream-SETUP-before-RECORD ordering (default unchanged), advertised local UDP data port, explicit initial/maximum volume policy, mandatory initial mute acknowledgement before audio/readiness, transient SRP event-channel key derivation and encrypted keep-alive handling, configurable input jitter reserve and presentation timestamps, and bounded protocol diagnostics/statistics. Corresponding protocol regression tests are included. See marked source files and docs/development.md. The example is omitted. Android integration lives in app/src/main/cpp.

Additional HomePod Bridge changes: optional Apple ALAC lossless encoding, per-packet byte/time counters, 20 ms minimum presentation target and low-latency/compressed-audio regression tests. Apple codec sources are separately pinned under third_party/apple-alac.

Additional HomePod Bridge changes: absolute sample-frame pacing with bounded catch-up and nanosecond Linux waits; switchable adaptive input reserve with zero-only trimming; bounded receiver latency negotiation and one compatibility retry; regression coverage for these paths.

HomePod Bridge also permits a 10 ms experimental presentation target, covered by AP1/AP2 timeline and mute-ACK tests.
